criteria.criterion: Every accepted transfer carries the preserved property/direction, bridge assumptions, supported fragment and independently checked proof/countermodel.
criteria.explanation: PCT-SAFE-Q1 is the only accepted consequence transfer: Q1 truth, source-implementation-to-target-query direction, identity-bridge assumptions, fragment q1-protected-write, related-model existence, Equations 7–8, consistent premises, and a four-assignment finite proof. PCT-UNSAFE-Q1 and PCT-DELAYED-AUDIT are accepted countermodels with the same receipt fields and explicit witnesses (unapproved protected write; audit at step 3 outside a complete [0,2] window). No accepted receipt is missing those fields or claims compiler soundness.

criteria.criterion: Safe, unsafe, delayed-audit, incomplete-window, wrong-tenant and inconsistent-premise examples have justified distinct outcomes.
criteria.explanation: The six required classes compute six different outcomes: safe q1_holds_on_guarded_model; unsafe q1_countermodel; delayed-audit violated_within_observed_window; incomplete-window unknown; wrong-tenant unresolved_identity; inconsistent-premise transfer_refused_inconsistent_premises. A late matching audit is a violation only with complete capture; an incomplete window is unknown; a tenant-b audit is not joined; Write and ¬Write premises are refused rather than exploded into Q1.

criteria.criterion: The conditional paper proposition is not represented as blanket machine-checked compiler soundness.
criteria.explanation: PROP1-CONDITIONAL records Proposition 1 as a paper-level conditional argument with machine_checked_compiler_soundness false and blanket_repository_soundness false. The suite states it does not establish extraction faithfulness, appropriateness of B, a nonempty model class, or that TDFOLToFOLConverter satisfies Equations 7–8. Lossy TDFOL erasure cases are rejected preservation failures, not accepted compiler theorems.

criteria.criterion: Missing native checkers or unsupported fragments are included in coverage/status reports.
criteria.explanation: Sealed-PATH probes report lean, lake, z3, cvc5, vampire, eprover, coqc, and isabelle unavailable; NATIVE-LEAN-Q1 is no_run/unavailable rather than a kernel proof. Coverage lists unsupported fragments contrary-to-duty and og-go-commutation, with UNSUPPORTED-CTD and UNSUPPORTED-OG-GO retained in the denominator as unsupported.
